plan:
I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2023-01-22 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 12:00, must finish by 24:00
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 08:45, must finish by 19:30

results.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.message: Your appliances are scheduled to run as follows: the washing machine will operate from 17:00 to 18:30, and the dishwasher will run from 21:30 to 22:30. This schedule keeps your energy costs low while ensuring everything is completed on time. The estimated total cost for this schedule is minimal, and it comfortably stays within your household peak load limit. Enjoy your clean dishes and laundry!
